newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain share index climbs to new all-time high.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain share index climbs to new all-time high.

text.p: The Bahrain stock market climbed to an all-time high in the week to Thursday, with the index notching up 8.56 points to a record 1,542.98 points.
The market reached a previous high of 1,539.23 points two weeks ago, and saw a slight downward correction last week.
The Bahrain Stock Exchange said trade volume fell sharply to 4.6 million shares worth 1.7 million dinars from 12.8 million shares worth 3.13 million dinars a week earlier.
The bourse said the banking and investment sectors dominated trade.
Investcorp was the most active stock with shares worth 740,811 dinars traded, it said.
The bourse said Bahrain Maritime and Mercantile International shares worth 324,825 dinars changed hands.
Shares of 19 firms of the 39 registered at the bourse were traded.
Bahrain's market is open to nationals in Gulf Arab states -- Saudi Araba, Kuwait, Qatar, Oman, Bahrain and the United Arab Emirates. Certain firms are also open to foreign investors.
